evals.prompt: My Antigravity agent in conversation <conversation-id> stopped a couple of days ago; I think it ran out of quota. Is it still running? What did its last three turns do, and why exactly did it stop? Cite steps.
evals.expected_output: Snapshots the summaries db and the conversation db (with -wal/-shm) into scratch and opens only the copies with mode=ro&immutable=1; reads the last database steps and finds the closing step_type 17 errors; decodes one with strings and quotes the 429 QUOTA_EXHAUSTED body with model and quotaResetTimeStamp; notes that the JSONL mirror lacks those steps (mirror versus database step counts); reports the server-restart notice that stopped subagents and background tasks; concludes stopped-failed and summarizes the last three turns with [created_at step=N] citations; never starts the app or agy and reads no token file.
assertions: Opens Antigravity databases only as copies under the scratch directory (no sqlite3 call on a path under ~/.gemini)
Concludes the conversation is stopped (stopped-failed), not running, and cites the evidence
Quotes the quota error with HTTP 429 or QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, the model name and the reset timestamp or delay
States that the JSONL mirror omits the closing error steps, with the mirror and database step counts or the missing step indexes
Reports the server-restart notice that stopped subagents and background tasks, with its time or step
Summarizes the last three turns with [created_at step=N] (or equivalent step-number) citations
Does not run the Antigravity app or the agy CLI and reads no token or credential file

evals.prompt: I'm taking over the work Antigravity was doing in <repo-substring>. Write me a takeover brief for conversation <conversation-id>: the plans and other artifacts it wrote, which ones I approved, what it committed or pushed, what's unfinished, and the first five things I should do.
evals.expected_output: Writes a digest and an eight-section brief (references/brief-template.md) to scratch; lists each brain artifact with path, updatedAt and SHA-256; identifies plan approvals from USER_INPUT steps saying 'The user has approved this document' with the artifact URI and step; reports commits, pushes and PRs from run_command calls and git output with steps; states the last state (clean idle or stopped on errors) with the final turn-final message; every claim carries [created_at step=N]; proposed and approved are kept apart.
assertions: Writes the brief to a file under the scratch/output directory with all eight template sections (role and scope, timeline, user decisions, last state, in-flight, blockers, takeover checklist, confidence notes)
Lists each top-level brain artifact (*.md) with its updatedAt and SHA-256
Identifies which artifacts the user approved from 'The user has approved this document' steps, naming the step numbers
Reports commits, pushes or PRs the conversation made, with step citations
States the conversation's last state (clean idle or stopped on errors) with the final turn-final message and its step
Cites claims with [created_at step=N] (or equivalent step-number) citations
Opens Antigravity databases only as copies under the scratch directory (no sqlite3 call on a path under ~/.gemini)

evals.prompt: Which of my Antigravity conversations talked about <term>? List them with where in each conversation it came up, and tell me how much of my Antigravity history that search actually covered.
evals.expected_output: Snapshots the summaries db, queries conversations_fts with MATCH and snippet(), then runs rg over the brain JSONL mirrors (and artifacts) for the conversations the index does not cover; lists the union with step locations (chunk step ranges or step_index); reports coverage as indexed N of M conversations, mirrors present for K of M, and which matches came only from rg; notes the other data roots (antigravity-cli has no FTS index).
assertions: Queries the conversations_fts full-text index with MATCH
Searches the brain transcript_full.jsonl mirrors with rg or grep to cover conversations outside the index
Reports index coverage as a count of indexed conversations out of the total in the summaries table
Reports how many conversations have a JSONL mirror (or how many were searchable) out of the total
Lists more matching conversations than the full-text index alone returns, and says which came only from the mirror search
Gives a step location (step_index or chunk step range) for each listed conversation
Opens Antigravity databases only as copies under the scratch directory (no sqlite3 call on a path under ~/.gemini)
